name: terminal-take
$comment: take caps the collect scan: compile_collect_terminal binds LIMIT = take over the index sort (unbound index fields, then created_at, then id — all in `order` direction). The seeded `order` values are distinct, so the index field alone determines the sequence and it is asserted IN ORDER (determinism ruling 2: explicit order over an index licenses sequence comparison); no insert-order tiebreak is relied on. Seeds are inserted in shuffled order so passing proves the sort, not insertion order.
